$comment: CLAUDE_V1_1 — GeoGebraPlus course file schema. See Spec_Course_Security_CLAUDE_V1_2.md for security constraints. V1_1 adds help and engine fields (Q-W9, GAP-1, GAP-2).
title: GeoGebraPlus Course
description: A hierarchical course definition for the GeoGebraPlus course tree panel (RCP and Web).

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Must be '1.0' for this schema.

course.description: Course title displayed in the tree panel header.

description.description: Optional course description shown in the tree panel.

locale.description: Locale for GeoGebra command names in this course (e.g., 'fr' for French commands). Commands are validated after GeoGebra's parser resolves them to internal names.

description.description: Instruction text shown to the student when this step is selected.

actions.description: Actions executed when the student clicks 'Run Step'. If empty or absent, the step is informational only.

check.description: Optional validation action executed when the student clicks 'Check'. Returns formative pass/fail.

children.description: Sub-steps. Maximum nesting depth: 4 (chapter + 4 step levels = 5 total).

help.description: Help content for this step. Either inline text or a reference to an external help template JSON file (Schema_Help_Template_JSON_CLAUDE_V1.json). Displayed in the help panel when the student requests help on this step.

engine.description: Which computation engine this step requires. 'giac' is the default (GeoGebra native CAS). Other engines are external (D-ENG-01..05): the binary must be on PATH, and the WIMS security filters apply.

directive.description: Action type. CMD: evalCommand. CAS: evalCommandCAS. VAL: read/display value. OPEN: load .ggb file. SAVE: save construction. PNG: export screenshot.

value.description: The command string, expression, variable name, or file path depending on the directive.

target.description: Which GeoGebra instance to target. RCP has separate 2D/3D APIs; web uses a single applet (3D commands work if 3D view is open).

trustedGgb.description: For OPEN actions only. If true, the .ggb file is loaded even if it contains embedded scripts. Teacher must vouch for the file. See security spec §3.2.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of what this action does.

template.description: Path to an external help template JSON file (relative to the course file). The file must conform to Schema_Help_Template_JSON_CLAUDE_V1.json. Example: 'aide_derivation.json'.

inline.description: Inline multilingual help text. Keys are locale codes. Supports {{variable}} placeholders and LaTeX between \( ... \). Use this for simple text help; use 'template' for structured resolution processes.

variables.description: Variable values to inject into the template or inline text. Overrides template defaults. Keys are variable names, values are the resolved OEF random values.

helpRef.description: Help reference: either an external template file path or inline multilingual text. At least one of 'template' or 'inline' must be present.

expected.description: Expected value. String for cas_equals, number for value_equals/value_range, ignored for object_exists.

pass.description: Message shown to the student on success.

fail.description: Message shown to the student on failure.
